raw_posts.name: MyClaw 3.0
raw_posts.tagline: Build an always-on AI team with shared memory
raw_posts.description: MyClaw lets you build your own AI team with OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent, Pi, and more. Give each teammate its own role, tools, skills, and choice of 50+ models, with shared memory across your team. Your agents run on always-on cloud computers, use your apps, access data, and handle recurring tasks even when you're offline. Assign work from the web, Slack, Telegram, or WhatsApp. No server setup or lock-in to a single AI provider.

raw_posts.name: Airbot
raw_posts.tagline: The AI chief of staff that texts you first
raw_posts.description: Most AI assistants wait for you to ask. Airbot texts you first. It checks the conversations, meetings, and customer updates spread across email, Slack, your calendar, and CRM, then brings you only the priorities that matter. Behind every message is work already prepared: a drafted response, a meeting brief, a booking, or a CRM change. Approve what should happen directly in WhatsApp or iMessage. Airbot helps founders and lean teams stay on top of work without living in their notifications.

raw_posts.name: Hiring Right Now
raw_posts.description: Paste your LinkedIn. Backdoor reads your work, searches growing startups and shows you the ones that fit, the founder to write to, and the email to send them. Free, no signup required, takes about two minutes.

raw_posts.name: Canva MCP
raw_posts.tagline: Turn any AI agent into a creative powerhouse
raw_posts.description: Canva MCP opens Canva's creative tools to AI agents and developers. Generate editable designs, images and videos, remove backgrounds, resize assets and automate on-brand creative workflows with MCP, REST APIs and CLI.

raw_posts.name: Snag by Parallel
raw_posts.tagline: Find the best deals on products from your agents
raw_posts.description: Find the best deals on the products you've been asking ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents about. Snag turns those conversations into a wishlist you import in one click, matches each item to the exact product, and checks prices across stores. Lists are sorted by best deal, every price is rated against its list price, and any list can be shared with a link. 100% free, in time for Black Friday. Powered by the Parallel Shopping API and Parallel Images API.

raw_posts.name: Fompi
raw_posts.tagline: Personal security & privacy companion that calls out risks
raw_posts.description: Fompi sits quietly in your browser and on your Mac, and speaks up when it matters: a scam page, a phishing email, a disguised download, an AI notetaker in your call, an app on your mic, a card number headed for an AI chat. It tells you why. Free to start :)

raw_posts.name: Koed
raw_posts.description: Koed gives each coding project its own Kin: a customisable assistant that remembers how you like to work, the decisions you’ve made and what you’ve already tried. Your Kin reasons over that context to give Claude Code, Codex and Pi guidance shaped by your project, helping your agents work faster and use fewer tokens. Koed runs on-device and is free and open source. It’s available now for solo developers, with more coding agent integrations, optional cloud processing and team sharing coming soon.

raw_posts.name: Hai
raw_posts.tagline: Your AI assistant that actually makes the phone call
raw_posts.description: Some bookings still only happen by phone, and plenty of us dread making that call. For people who are deaf, hard of hearing, or have speech or anxiety barriers, that call can be impossible. Hai makes it for you. Tell your assistant what you need, approve the plan, and Hai places the call in any language to any business that takes bookings by phone, then reports back in text. Free to start. Built by an indie developer in Japan.

raw_posts.name: Omi X 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: Omi can build anything. Your $1B idea, live in production
raw_posts.description: Omi can build anything. Omi X 2.0 is the desktop app for Mac and Windows that builds a production AI SaaS on your own Google Cloud and Firebase. New in 2.0: Point and edit lets you click any part of your running app and tell Omi what to change. Open an existing project brings in your own Next.js app; Omi tests, builds and deploys it. New projects start from a tested starter. Plan free, no card; building from $29 a month.

raw_posts.name: RelayRunner
raw_posts.tagline: Swap between CI runners on-demand with zero code changes.
raw_posts.description: RelayRunner is a router for your existing CI runners, so you can use multiple providers or self-hosted options at the same time. Send each GitHub Actions job to the first free runner in your order: your own Mac, self-hosted runners, GitHub's default runners, or providers like Blacksmith and Boat. Change the order any time without touching your workflows. Open source, with a Mac app and a CLI that turn any machine into a runner on-demand.
